subject.title: Bound plugin bundle command file reads with size cap

question: Should installed plugin bundle command Markdown have a supported 1 MiB maximum, with larger existing commands skipped after a warning rather than loaded or rejected at installation time?
rationale: The diff deliberately changes upgrade behavior for already installed command files above the new cap; code review can verify the mechanics but cannot select the product compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept warning-and-skip cap
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB cap and file-specific warning, accepting that oversized existing commands stop loading until the bundle is corrected.

options.title: Move enforcement earlier
options.body: Require the bundle install or validation owner to reject oversized command files before activation if maintainers want a stronger operator-facing contract.

options.title: Choose a different limit
options.body: Retain bounded reads but set a separately justified command-file maximum if 1 MiB is too restrictive for supported bundles.

recommendation.title: Accept warning-and-skip cap
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 MiB cap and file-specific warning, accepting that oversized existing commands stop loading until the bundle is corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related merged bounded-read work and this concrete implementation, making them the closest available technical routing candidate; permanent compatibility direction remains a maintainer decision.
